biography.plain_text: Abdulla Mohamed Al Masaood was an Emirati businessman from Abu Dhabi’s established merchant community. He helped establish the Al Masaood Group with his brothers, built its international automotive partnerships and later developed Abdulla Al Masaood & Sons. He chaired the wider group until retiring in 2017 and died in February 2019.

long_biography.plain_text:
Abdulla Al Masaood chaired Abu Dhabi’s National Consultative Council, advising the government and connecting it with the public. He received an Abu Dhabi Award for his charitable and international work. His contributions included support for children’s education and for cultural, social and business initiatives overseas.

Within Abdulla Al Masaood & Sons, he worked with his sons Humaid and Khalifa as joint owners and decision-makers. His enthusiasm for starting companies influenced Humaid, who joined him in the family businesses. He founded the UAE Harley-Davidson dealership operation, whose Dubai showroom opened in 1993 and Abu Dhabi counterpart in 1995.
